access.line: Sacrifice this creature: Draw a card. Activate only if an opponent has eight or more cards in their graveyard.
Surveil 2, then draw two cards. Notion Rain deals 2 damage to you.

When this artifact enters, you may look at the top four cards of your library. If you do, reveal up to one land card from among them, then put that card on top of your library and the rest on the bottom in a random order.
If this spell was bargained, look at the top four cards of your library, then put up to two of them back on top of your library in any order and the rest into your graveyard.
You draw two cards and you lose 2 life.
